# Steadcore Property Group

> Bournemouth-based property services company covering the south of England, within roughly a two-hour radius of Bournemouth (Dorset, Hampshire, Wiltshire, Somerset, East Devon, West Sussex).

## Security alarms (key service)
- [Security alarm installation, Bournemouth and South UK](https://www.steadcorepropertygroup.co.uk/security/): Intruder alarms, sensors and CCTV for homes and businesses.
- [Security alarm Bournemouth](https://www.steadcorepropertygroup.co.uk/security/bournemouth/): Local alarm installation in Bournemouth, Poole and Christchurch.
- [Security alarm South UK](https://www.steadcorepropertygroup.co.uk/security/south-england/): Alarm installation across southern England.
